Give me 3 bullet points summarizing this:

A year-long study of 2,400 office workers found that people who took a short walk after lunch reported better afternoon focus than those who stayed at their desks. The effect was strongest on days with long meetings. Walkers also took fewer sick days, though the researchers note that healthier people may simply be more likely to walk. The authors recommend that employers protect a 15-minute break after lunch rather than scheduling meetings through it.

Summarize the pros and cons of this in a table:

Electric scooters are cheap to rent and fun to ride, and they can replace short car trips in crowded cities. They produce no exhaust while riding. On the other hand, riders are often injured, especially without helmets, and scooters left on sidewalks block wheelchair users. Their batteries wear out quickly, so many scooters last only a year or two, and collecting them for charging each night adds emissions from vans.

Summarize this research abstract in plain language:

We surveyed 300 hospital nurses about their sleep and job satisfaction. Of the respondents, 180 worked night shifts and 150 worked day shifts. Night-shift nurses reported 52 minutes less sleep per workday on average and lower job satisfaction scores. Nurses who had at least two consecutive days off reported better sleep, regardless of shift. We recommend that hospitals schedule rest days in blocks of two or more to reduce fatigue among night-shift staff.

Summarize this, though honestly I think it's nonsense:

School uniforms do more good than harm. They reduce the pressure on families to buy expensive clothes and make it harder to tell which students come from wealthier homes. Teachers in schools that adopted uniforms report fewer arguments about dress codes. Critics say uniforms limit self-expression, but students still express themselves through clubs, art, and how they treat one another. Uniforms are a small rule that removes a daily distraction.

Summarize this:

Honeybees are remarkable insects. A single worker bee makes about a full jar of honey over its lifetime, which is why a hive can produce so much in one season. Worker bees are all female and live only five to six weeks in summer. They tell each other where flowers are through a 'waggle dance' that signals both direction and distance. Beekeepers usually harvest honey in late summer, leaving enough for the colony to survive the winter.

What's the main point of this?

Many people assume that recycling more is the best thing they can do for the environment. But recycling uses energy, and much of what goes into recycling bins is never actually recycled. Reducing what we buy and reusing what we already own saves far more resources. Recycling still matters, but it should be the last step, not the first, in how we think about waste.
